digest.greeting: Good morning, Jean. Today is Wednesday, August 5, with nine scheduled meetings, two hard conflicts, a 2.5-hour focus block, six urgent items, and five carry-overs. The day turns on the 10:00 AM Legal collision and the 2:30-5:00 PM portfolio and leadership run. First, close the critical Supabase exposure; then stabilize the VAWA and Amazon Connect delivery paths and use the Legal and BD reviews to settle ownership and capacity. SMS Optimization is staying active, while a possible Detention Prevention pause still awaits Sara's confirmation.

items.detail: Sara confirmed SMS Optimization will not pause and said not to assign Bonus/Comp to Laura. Await her decision on a possible Detention Prevention pause, and align the operating model now that SMS Magic changes must stay with IT and Deepak is the main contact after Josh's transition.

items.label: Close the remaining portfolio and staffing roadblocks

Confirm the 250 UAT numbers and configuration path, reconcile the email's older production-blocker status, and hold owners to Round 1 UAT on August 13 and the August 27 go/no-go.

Schedule the proposed Jean-Shannon-Sara discussion and decide whether Nicolas is contingency support or part of a broader handoff.
